question: How do out-of-tree CSI volume plugins differ from legacy in-tree volume plugins, and which advanced storage operations in the supplied documentation depend on CSI?

attempts.raw_model_output: {"abstain":false,"answer":"Out-of-tree CSI volume plugins differ from legacy in-tree volume plugins in that they enable storage vendors to create custom storage plugins without adding their plugin source code to the Kubernetes repository. FlexVolume is deprecated and using an out-of-tree CSI driver is the recommended way to integrate external storage with Kubernetes.
